crossRefs.note: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;
and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield…
If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that…
Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the…
Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and…
They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the…
Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit…
For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…

translations.web: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;
translations.bsb: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,
translations.kjv: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
translations.asv: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from Jehovah our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
